cycles.focus: Phase 2 T2.2 — re-entry FX (plasma + heat-shimmer + white flash + speed-coupled shake)
units: T2.2 re-entry FX — the violence of punching into the atmosphere, easing into the calm descent. VISUAL half (procedural-modeler, podScene.ts): PLASMA_FS additive ionized-air streak-threads (dark lanes so the vista shows through) with a white-hot core at the windward leading edge + a slipstream-raked diagonal flow, clipped to the porthole (no cabin spill); SHIMMER_FS additive heat-wobble over the vista. FELT half (main loop, sequence.ts tickDescent): flashScreen(0xfff2e6,0.7) one-shot at the peak + addTrauma(0.04 + re*0.45) buffet over the base fall-rumble. BOTH on ONE shared curve re=max(0,1-((p-0.24)/0.16)^2) — 0 at p≈0.08, peak p≈0.24, gone by p≈0.40, so re-entry is HIGH+EARLY and finishes BEFORE the desert cross-fade (~0.34→0.48), avoiding the warm-layer stack. setDescentProgress(0..1) contract preserved; materials disposed in disposePodScene.
cycles.visual: 2-round CONFIRM GATE (light, proportionate for FX over the already-gated vista). Round-1 FAILED: the gate caught an INVERTED arc (the re curve faded too slowly → the plasma stacked on the warm desert cross-fade so the FADE frame read brighter than the PEAK + occluded the vista), campfire-orange (no white-hot core), a hard horizontal decal-seam band. Round-2 fixed all three (tighter curve [the same one in sequence.ts], a blown white-hot core, a turbulence-warped + slipstream-directional band) → RE-CONFIRM PASS: both critics hitsBar=true, beauty 8, all booleans true (arc correct, white-hot core, band broken, bookends clean [orbit+surface=zero plasma], no cabin spill, vista glimpsed). Noted sev-3 polish (whiter/larger core, vista dim at peak) → walk-test. The felt re-entry MOTION (flash+shake+flicker) is a Phase-2 walk-test item.
decisions: (no new D-entry. Technique notes in the changelog: split hero-ish FX into a modeler visual half + a main-loop felt half on a SHARED driver curve [kept byte-identical across the two files]; time re-entry HIGH+EARLY so it doesn't stack on the desert cross-fade; additive toneMapped:false white-hot core for ionized-air read; GLSL backtick-in-comment breaks the TS template literal [caught by the modeler].)

cycles.focus: Phase 2 T2.3 — the tumbling reveal + interior-lit-by-exterior (COMPLETES PHASE 2)
units: T2.3 the tumbling reveal — reworked the shipExplode beat (sequence.ts) into the cinematic, ALL MAIN-LOOP (camera/light staging, no new geometry): on eject the ship dies in a blast + the pod is flung TUMBLING, settling into the descent. The beat goes mode='scripted' + eases an intro tumble intensity (scratch.tumble: 1 at the blast → 0 settled, smoothstep). The controller's NEW applyIntroTumble rides it as a decaying tumbled camera POSE (roll ~1.45rad + pitch-up toward the blast + yaw + a jostle wobble), post-multiplied onto the look exactly like applyStormCameraSway (undo-last-frame so it never accumulates on the PointerLockControls orientation). faceControl(0,0) at init sets the base look to the descent framing → the tumble settles seamlessly into the descent (no snap). A settling buffet (addTrauma 0.05+settle*0.30) + the eject kick decay with it. NEW podScene.setTumbleLight(settle) floods the cabin hot blast-orange at the explosion (porthole-spill PointLight → 0xff7a2e @ intensity 3.5, brighter ambient) decaying to the orbital cool (settle=0 == the descent's setDescentProgress(0) cool → seamless handoff). Builds on the C15 light refs. SHIP_EXPLODE_DWELL 2.5→4.0s for the tumble to read+settle.

DoD met (the descent plays as the vision describes).
decisions: (no new D-entry. Technique notes in the changelog: drive a scripted intro CAMERA via a controller post-multiply [the storm-sway applyStormCameraSway pattern: undo-last-frame, post-multiply] rather than fighting PointerLockControls — 'scripted' mode only locks LOCOMOTION, the look stays controls-owned; settle the tumble onto faceControl(0,0) so the descent handoff is snap-free. The hero ship explosion through the tumble frame = Phase 3 — the staging + setTumbleLight blast-flood hook are built here.)
